headings.usage: Use 'font-black' for primary dashboard titles and 'font-light' for secondary section headers to create radical weight contrast.

body.usage: Used for all tabular data, tool metadata, command line scripts, and general body text to enforce the developer/CLI aesthetic.

colors.usage_rules: Strict monochrome base (Deep Void Black to Stark White). Accent colors (Cyber Yellow, Signal Red, Laser Green) are used ONLY for functional states (validation, active feeds, command triggers). No full-screen gradients.

surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background (#0A0A0A), 1px solid border (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)), NO shadow. Hover state: border color brightens to rgba(255,255,255,0.3) with a subtle -translate-y-1 lift.
surfaces.header_nav: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and a delicate border-b border-white/10. NEVER fully transparent.
surfaces.terminal_windows: For install commands, use a pure #000000 background, 1px border-white/10, and JetBrains Mono font. Add a subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(34,197,94,0.3)] on the text for a glowing effect.

visual_enhancers.borders: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse on containers and 1px border-white/10 on grid items to create a technical, data-heavy look.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise/grain SVG overlay fixed over the background with pointer-events-none and 3% opacity to kill the digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: The Bento Grid Protocol (Mode B: High Density Grid)
grids_and_layouts.container: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6

spans.live_feed: col-span-1 row-span-2 (Tall narrow list on the right or left for the 08:44 timestamped feed).

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding for cards (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision with borders. Use Optical Alignment for icons next to text.
grids_and_layouts.constraints: Images/visuals must not exceed 80vh on mobile. Max layout width container with mx-auto.

components.buttons: Sharp, rectangular pill or flat styles. NO over-rounded corners. Hover state: hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white. Active state explicitly defined.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but customized to pure dark mode: bg-black border-white/10 text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00E5FF].
components.tables: Dense, minimalist. Use border-b border-white/10 for rows. Striped rows (bg-white/[0.02]) for readability.
components.tabs: Override default Shadcn h-9 to h-auto to prevent cutoff. Sharp borders.
components.toasts: Use Sonner component with dark theme, sharp corners, and 1px border-white/10.

motion.interactions: Hover states must increase contrast and border brightness. Buttons scale down 0.98 on active.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in (Framer Motion) for grid items. Delay each item by 0.05s.
motion.live_feed: Use react-fast-marquee for a subtle, constant upward or horizontal scroll of the '1111 aggregated sites' status ticker.
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Do not use generic 'transition: all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use APCA calculator guidelines.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00E5FF] focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='copy-install-command-btn').

images.description: Abstract green matrix code background to reinforce the backend/CLI theme.
Server rack imagery for DevOps/Kubernetes related modules.
Cyberpunk city neon to be used at low opacity for auth/login screen background.

icons.usage: Use Phosphor Icons (duotone or bold) for a dense, technical developer tool aesthetic. Run 'yarn add @phosphor-icons/react'.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize depth through layered borders (1px solid over flat backgrounds) rather than drop shadows, sticking to the technical dashboard vibe.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css. Keep text logically aligned (left for data, centered only for specific empty states).
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖🧠) for icons. Use the specified icon library (@phosphor-icons/react).
Always explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-white hover:text-black).
Do NOT use HTML native date pickers or select dropdowns. ALWAYS use customized Shadcn UI components.
Implement the '1111 sources' validation as a technical status indicator, using Terminal-like output displays.
Ensure the '08:44 Germany Time' refresh timestamp is prominently displayed as a tactical dashboard widget.
Use pure `.js` and `.jsx` extensions as this environment uses JavaScript, not TypeScript.
